targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_filesystem_avail_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND NOT match(Attributes['device'], '^rootfs$') AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['mountpoint'], '- Free') AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_filesystem_free_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND NOT match(Attributes['device'], '^rootfs$') AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['mountpoint'], '- Size') AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_filesystem_size_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND NOT match(Attributes['device'], '^rootfs$') AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Filesystem Space Available

panels.description: Disk usage (used = total - available) per mountpoint

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, a - b AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS series, argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName='node_filesystem_size_bytes') AS a, argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName='node_filesystem_avail_bytes') AS b FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('node_filesystem_size_bytes','node_filesystem_avail_bytes') AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND NOT match(Attributes['device'], 'rootfs') AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series) ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Filesystem Used

panels.description: Percentage of time the disk was actively processing I/O operations

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(delta) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['device'] AS series, argMax(d / nullIf(dt, 0), TimeUnix) AS delta FROM (SELECT *, dateDiff('millisecond', lagInFrame(TimeUnix, 1, TimeUnix) OVER w, TimeUnix) / 1000 AS dt, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_disk_io_time_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND match(Attributes['device'], '^([a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|mmcblk[0-9]+)$') AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime  GROUP BY time, series, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Disk I/O Utilization

panels.description:
How often tasks experience CPU, memory, or I/O delays. “Some” indicates partial slowdown; “Full” indicates all tasks are stalled. Based on Linux PSI metrics:
https://docs.kernel.org/accounting/psi.html

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'CPU - Some' AS series, d AS delta FROM (SELECT *, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime ) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Memory - Some' AS series, d AS delta FROM (SELECT *, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime ) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Memory - Full' AS series, d AS delta FROM (SELECT *, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_pressure_memory_stalled_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime ) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'I/O - Some' AS series, d AS delta FROM (SELECT *, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime ) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'I/O - Full' AS series, d AS delta FROM (SELECT *, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime ) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT time, series, sum(delta)/greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'IRQ - Full' AS series, d AS delta FROM (SELECT *, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS d FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_pressure_irq_stalled_seconds_total' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime ) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Pressure Stall Information

panels.description: Displays committed memory usage versus the system's commit limit. Exceeding the limit is allowed under Linux overcommit policies but may increase OOM risks under high load

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Committed_AS – Memory promised to processes (not necessarily used)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Committed_AS_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'CommitLimit - Max allowable committed memory' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_CommitLimit_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Committed

panels.description: Memory currently dirty (modified but not yet written to disk), being actively written back, or held by writeback buffers. High dirty or writeback memory may indicate disk I/O pressure or delayed flushing

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Writeback – Memory currently being flushed to disk' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Writeback_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'WritebackTmp – FUSE temporary writeback buffers' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_WritebackTmp_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Dirty – Memory marked dirty (pending write to disk)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Dirty_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'NFS Unstable – Pages sent to NFS server, awaiting storage commit' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_NFS_Unstable_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Writeback and Dirty

panels.description: Kernel slab memory usage, separated into reclaimable and non-reclaimable categories. Reclaimable memory can be freed under memory pressure (e.g., caches), while unreclaimable memory is locked by the kernel for core functions

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'SUnreclaim – Non-reclaimable slab memory (kernel objects)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_SUnreclaim_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'SReclaimable – Potentially reclaimable slab memory (e.g., inode cache)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_SReclaimable_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Slab

panels.description: Memory used for mapped files (such as libraries) and shared memory (shmem and tmpfs), including variants backed by huge pages

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Mapped – Memory mapped from files (e.g., libraries, mmap)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Mapped_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Shmem – Shared memory used by processes and tmpfs' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Shmem_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'ShmemHugePages – Shared memory (shmem/tmpfs) allocated with HugePages' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_ShmemHugePages_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'PMD Mapped – Shmem/tmpfs backed by Transparent HugePages (PMD)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_ShmemPmdMapped_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Shared and Mapped

panels.description: Proportion of memory pages in the kernel's active and inactive LRU lists relative to total RAM. Active pages have been recently used, while inactive pages are less recently accessed but still resident in memory

targets.rawSql: SELECT s0.time AS time, 'Inactive – Less recently used memory, more likely to be reclaimed' AS series, s0.a / nullIf(s1.b,0) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, max(Value) AS a FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Inactive_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time) s0 INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, max(Value) AS b FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_MemTotal_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time) s1 ON s0.time=s1.time ORDER BY time, series

SELECT s0.time AS time, 'Active – Recently used memory, retained unless under pressure' AS series, s0.a / nullIf(s1.b,0) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, max(Value) AS a FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Active_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time) s0 INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, max(Value) AS b FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_MemTotal_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time) s1 ON s0.time=s1.time ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory LRU Active / Inactive (%)

panels.description: Breakdown of memory pages in the kernel's active and inactive LRU lists, separated by anonymous (heap, tmpfs) and file-backed (caches, mmap) pages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Inactive_file - File-backed memory on inactive LRU list' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Inactive_file_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Inactive_anon – Anonymous memory on inactive LRU (incl. tmpfs & swap cache)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Inactive_anon_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Active_file - File-backed memory on active LRU list' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Active_file_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Active_anon – Anonymous memory on active LRU (incl. tmpfs & swap cache)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Active_anon_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory LRU Active / Inactive Detail

panels.description: Tracks kernel memory used for CPU-local structures, per-thread stacks, and bounce buffers used for I/O on DMA-limited devices. These areas are typically small but critical for low-level operations

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'KernelStack – Kernel stack memory (per-thread, non-reclaimable)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_KernelStack_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'PerCPU – Dynamically allocated per-CPU memory (used by kernel modules)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Percpu_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Bounce Memory – I/O buffer for DMA-limited devices' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Bounce_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Kernel / CPU / IO

panels.description: Usage of the kernel's vmalloc area, which provides virtual memory allocations for kernel modules and drivers. Includes total, used, and largest free block sizes

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Vmalloc Free Chunk – Largest available block in vmalloc area' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_VmallocChunk_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Vmalloc Total – Total size of the vmalloc memory area' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_VmallocTotal_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Vmalloc Used – Portion of vmalloc area currently in use' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Vmalloc

panels.description: Memory used by anonymous pages (not backed by files), including standard and huge page allocations. Includes heap, stack, and memory-mapped anonymous regions

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'AnonHugePages – Anonymous memory using HugePages' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_AnonHugePages_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'AnonPages – Anonymous memory (non-file-backed)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_AnonPages_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Anonymous

panels.description: Memory that is locked in RAM and cannot be swapped out. Includes both kernel-unevictable memory and user-level memory locked with mlock()

matcher.options: Hardware Corrupted - Amount of RAM that the kernel identified as corrupted / not working

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Unevictable – Kernel-pinned memory (not swappable)' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Unevictable_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'Mlocked – Application-locked memory via mlock()' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_Mlocked_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory Unevictable and MLocked

panels.description: How much memory is directly mapped in the kernel using different page sizes (4K, 2M, 1G). Helps monitor large page utilization in the direct map region

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'DirectMap 1G – Memory mapped with 1GB pages' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_DirectMap1G_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'DirectMap 2M – Memory mapped with 2MB pages' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_DirectMap2M_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'DirectMap 4K – Memory mapped with 4KB pages' AS series, max(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_DirectMap4k_bytes' AND ServiceName = '$job' AND ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = '$node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Memory DirectMap

panels.description: Displays HugePages memory usage in bytes, including allocated, free, reserved, and surplus memory. All values are calculated based on the number of huge pages multiplied by their configured size
